local_storage: last status, HTTP code, check time and latency
interval, notifications and HTTP consent settings
network_data: connection source IP visible to destination
reason: HTTP can be explicitly enabled; do not claim all transmissions encrypted
collection_form_review: Conservatively disclose user-supplied website URLs as collected for app functionality. No telemetry to developer. Final mapping requires the live Console form; do not submit a blanket no-data-collected answer.
sharing_form_review: Evaluate the user-initiated transfer exception separately from collection. Adding a monitored site explicitly discloses ongoing requests to that site.
ephemeral_reason: Remote server log retention is outside app control
deletion: Remove a site in the app or clear app storage. Cannot erase already-sent requests or remote website logs.
